run_cutlass_scaled_fp4_mm: run cutlass_scaled_fp4_mm to perform FP4 matrix multiplication with scales and alpha
run_scaled_fp4_quant: run scaled_fp4_quant to quantize a float tensor to NVFP4 format with interleaved scales
test_nvfp4_gemm: test the test_nvfp4_gemm function for NVFP4 GEMM correctness across dtypes and shapes
run_get_ref_results: run get_ref_results to compute reference output by dequantizing FP4 tensors and matmul
run_dequantize_to_dtype: run dequantize_to_dtype to dequantize an NVFP4 tensor and scale tensor back to float32
